quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to prevent traffic congestion.
Change lanes if it is safe to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes if it is safe to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When driving on a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering the roadway. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Be ready to watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They get you ready for upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming so you can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means you are approaching a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go if the road is clear.
Drive carefully through the intersection but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided by a median or divider. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: At a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to traffic on the right.
Yield just to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay to the right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves to the right. Reduce your speed to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the side, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left. Hand signals can be used instead of or with mechanical turn signals.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean? Left arm bent at the elbow pointing upward.
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points upward, it means they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right. Hand signals can be used instead of mechanical turn signals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching
Come to a full stop and proceed when safe
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and proceed when safe
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or heading toward the intersection go first. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Slow down and be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface becomes slippery when wet. Reduce speed and use caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right
The road ahead curves right, then left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering from the right side. Stay alert and be prepared for vehicles joining your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot drive in this direction. It is not safe to enter this road or driveway from where you are. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue driving in your current direction on this road.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a narrow bridge is coming. Be careful and do not try to pass trucks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign tells you that U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show their turns. A left arm extended straight out means the rider is turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. All traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Slow down, enter at low speed, and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way roads with a median between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: Can pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
Can pass if you know the road.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must follow them. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road is joining from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic light is coming up. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or steering, and keep more distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs display laws that drivers must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and let other traffic go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs with black symbols on yellow warn drivers about hazards ahead on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs with black markings on yellow alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you to drive carefully when it rains because wet pavement is slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down to avoid damaging your brakes or losing control.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. A bent left arm pointing downward means you are going to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does the speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The fastest safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The fastest safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are not ideal. Always slow down in bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction and maintenance signs are orange. They warn drivers about work zones and dangerous conditions ahead. Slow down and be very careful in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways at the intersection.
Slow down and stop if you need to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if you need to.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and other traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue through or exit the freeway from this lane.
You can stay in this lane and continue through.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in this lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane does not continue through the interchange. It becomes an exit ramp. If you are under this sign, you can change lanes to continue through, or you must exit the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in groups communicate. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the overhead clearance is low.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Wrong-way entry to one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way entry to one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic moves in one direction only. You must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs always mean stop. You must stop completely and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may cross the road or ride near traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Truck route is to the left.

questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road is crossing a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road is crossing a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that drivers must obey. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and tell you about road hazards. This sign warns that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger, all riders should form a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that drivers must obey. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it means riders should go faster.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay to the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red, yellow, or green lights and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Certain turns are allowed only from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers can use this lane, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of opposite traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead directing traffic in a construction zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer may cross the road. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road may be wet and slippery, so drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider holds their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should get ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead, so stay alert.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park in this area. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Watch for pedestrians at intersections and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider puts their left arm straight down with palm back, all riders in the group should stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending. Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to turn either right or left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains cross first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains cross first.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed for exiting a highway.
The safe speed for entering a highway.
The safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for exiting a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended safe speed for exiting a highway. The number shown is the maximum safe speed for that exit.
